title: Implement and qualify optional whole-service Go background-worker

acceptance_criteria.description: Replace whole worker while preserving all configured source contracts.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Early runnable dual-config health/notification worker with actual Haskell comparison; federation pusher, DLQ watcher, Rabbit group sync, Arbiter scheduled adminless/meetings, all seven migrations and lifecycle implemented. No supported path silent no-op; original protected assertions and schemas unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.description: Validate finite source gaps and final exact executable with current pinned Go tooling.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Format/tidy/verify/vet/race/unit/build/security/license checks; source14 pusher expectations, strict input/TLS/job/header/lease guards and inherited serious concerns. Final exact original77+worker47 six-Go/Haskell peer tests all pass with strict XML, identity and owned cleanup. No baseline failure silently waived.

acceptance_criteria.description: Prove bounded operations and actual durable switchback.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: One predeclared health/jobs/RSS/CPU/latency and loaded shutdown smoke; Haskell-Go-Haskell identical Rabbit/PG/Cass state with queued/scheduled jobs, lease/attempt guards, notifications and migration continuation. Matching nonroot optional container with trusted CA, health and SIGTERM; exact artifacts and delegated self-review. Protected selector work separately scoped.
